EVENT_NOTE_QUADRANT: Four a side, two strikers. Served from behind the back line.
EVENT_NOTE_DOUBLES: Two a side: a server and a striker cover the whole court.

DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: World-class opponents. Every touch must be on time.

VENUE_MALL_DESC: A court in a shopping mall, fans on every floor, as the world championship is played.
VENUE_PROVINCIAL_DESC: A wooden floor, a few rows of seats and fans turning overhead.
VENUE_TEMPLE_DESC: Outdoors in front of the temple, where many players first learn.
VENUE_PARK_DESC: An evening game under the floodlights.
VENUE_BEACH_DESC: Beach takraw on the sand at sunset.
VENUE_STREET_DESC: A street court by the market stalls, strings of lights overhead.

LEAGUE_NOTE_ID: Eight city clubs from across the islands. A round robin, then the Final Four.
ABANDON_SEASON_Q: Abandon this season? It cannot be undone.

CUP_ROYAL_DESC: The yearly world championship, played on a court in a shopping mall.
CUP_ASIA_DESC: Asia's nations in the National Arena.
CUP_SEA_DESC: The region's great rivalries, in a provincial gym.
OUT_OF_CUP: Your tournament is over. See how it ends?
FAULT_FOOT: Fault: the server's foot left the circle
HINT_SERVE: The feeder throws: press Serve as the ring closes on the ball.
HINT_RECEIVE: Your player runs to it: press Kick as the ring closes.
HINT_DIG: A spike is coming: Dig as it arrives.
HINT_SET: Set it up for your striker: Set (high), Quick set, or Attack it yourself.
HINT_ATTACK: Spike it! Aim with the joystick as you press.
HINT_BLOCK: Their striker is going up: Block as he hits.
ASSIST_OFF_NOTE: You run your player to the ball with the joystick, and time every touch.
ASSIST_RUN_NOTE: Your player runs to the ball; you time the touch and aim.
ASSIST_FULL_NOTE: Your player runs and times the touch; you choose the spike and aim.
GFX_NOTE: Low keeps budget phones smooth; the game picks it for you on a Galaxy A16 and phones like it.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: About {n} frames a second: longer battery, a cooler phone.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: {n} frames a second on your {hz} Hz screen.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: As many frames as your {hz} Hz screen shows.
LICENCES_INTRO: What the game is made with, and under what licences.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: 13.40 m by 6.10 m, a badminton doubles court. The net is 1.52 m high for men and 1.42 m for women. A quarter circle by the net on each side, and a service circle 2.45 m from each back line.
RULES_PLAYERS_TEXT: Three players: the tekong, who serves from the back; the feeder, who sets; and the striker, who spikes. Quadrant is four a side, doubles two.
RULES_SERVE_TEXT: An inside player throws the ball to the tekong, who kicks it over with one foot in the service circle. Both inside players must stand in their quarter circles until it is kicked. The serve passes to the other side after every point.
RULES_TOUCHES_TEXT: Feet, knees, chest and head: never the hands or arms. Three touches a side at most, and one player may make all three.
RULES_SCORE_TEXT: Every rally wins a point. Sets go to 15; from 14 all a set must be won by two, up to 17. Best of three sets. Ends change after each set, and at 8 in the third.
RULES_FAULTS_TEXT: Touching the net, the ball on a hand or arm, a fourth touch, the ball under the net or outside the boundary tape, the server's standing foot leaving the circle.
RULES_CHALLENGE_TEXT: One challenge a side a set on a line call. Win it and you keep it.
CTRL_TIMING_TEXT: When a touch is yours, a ring closes on the ball. Press as it meets the gold circle: PERFECT is the best touch, GOOD close behind.
CTRL_SERVE_TEXT: Serve for a steady instep serve, Horse kick for the fast sole serve over the shoulder. Aim with the joystick.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Kick (or Dig against a spike) as the ring closes. A good first touch reaches your feeder by the net.
CTRL_SET_TEXT: Set lofts it high for a roll spike; Quick set is lower and faster; Attack surprises them with a second-touch kill.
CTRL_SPIKE_TEXT: Spike plays your striker's signature spike. Push the joystick to aim; Feint drops it softly over the block.
CTRL_BLOCK_TEXT: When they set their striker, Block appears: jump as he hits.
CTRL_ASSIST_TEXT: With Assist on Run your player runs to the ball for you; on Full he times the touch too. Off: run him yourself.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD or arrows to aim and move, Space for the first button, J and K for the others.
MOVE_SILA_TEXT: The inside-of-the-foot kick: the basic receive and set.
MOVE_KUDA_TEXT: The instep kick, stretched out for low balls and digs.
MOVE_HORSE_TEXT: The sunback serve: turned away from the net, the sole whips the ball over the shoulder.
MOVE_ROLL_TEXT: The full somersault, the foot driving the ball down over the shoulder at up to 130 km/h. Thailand's trademark.
MOVE_SUNBACK_TEXT: A jumping horse kick, side-on, the legs scissoring: the Malaysian kalih.
MOVE_TAPAK_TEXT: The tapak: the sole stamps the ball down over the net.
MOVE_HEADER_TEXT: To receive, to set, or to spike from the net.
MOVE_FEINT_TEXT: A soft touch just over the block when they expect the spike.
MOVE_BLOCK_TEXT: A jump at the net, legs up, to stop the spike coming through.
